lessons.principle_en: Identify the main idea — what are the speakers mainly discussing?
lessons.principle_ar: حدّد الفكرة الرئيسية — ما الذي يناقشه المتحدثان بشكل أساسي؟
lessons.strategy_ar: ركّز على أول 2-3 جمل لفهم موضوع الحوار، ولا تشتت ذهنك بالتفاصيل الصغيرة.

clips.context_ar: مقطع تمهيدي — استمع لأسلوب الحوار الطبيعي
lines: Hey, are you heading to lunch?
Yeah, I was thinking of trying the new cafe on campus.
Oh, the one near the library? I heard their sandwiches are great.
Exactly. Want to come with me?
Sure, let me grab my bag.

clips.context_ar: حوار حول وجبة الغداء في الكافتيريا
lines: Not yet. I was waiting for you. Where should we go?
The cafeteria is serving pasta and salad today. It's only five dollars.
That sounds perfect. The Student Center is too crowded at this hour.
Agreed. Let's head to the cafeteria before the line gets long.
Good idea. Do they still have that lemon dressing I like?
I think so. Come on, let's go.

questions.q: Where are the students planning to go for lunch?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكر الطالب صراحةً 'The cafeteria is serving pasta and salad'، وأكدا قرارهما بالذهاب إلى الكافتيريا.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الـ Student Center ذُكر فقط بأنه مزدحم، والمكتبة لم تُذكر كمكان للأكل.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ابحث عن المكان الذي وافقا على الذهاب إليه، ليس المكان الذي رفضاه.

questions.q: What kind of food is being served?
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر بوضوح 'pasta and salad today' كقائمة طعام اليوم.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الـ Sandwiches ذُكرت في المقطع التمهيدي عن كافيه مختلف، وليس هنا.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: استمع للتفاصيل الدقيقة عن قائمة الطعام في هذا الحوار تحديداً.

clips.context_ar: حوار عن افتتاح مطعم جديد قرب الحرم
lines: Did you hear about the new Italian place that just opened?
Right across from the main gate. They have authentic pizza.
Sounds amazing. How are the prices?
A bit higher than the cafeteria, but worth it for a weekend treat.
Let's try it Saturday night then.
Perfect. I'll make a reservation for seven.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explanation_ar: الحوار يدور حول مطعم إيطالي افتُتح حديثاً قرب البوابة الرئيسية، وقررا تجربته.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لم يُذكر أي صف طبخ أو مهرجان طعام؛ فقط مطعم جديد.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ركّز على الكلمة المتكررة في الحوار: ما الذي يدور حوله النقاش؟

questions.q: When do they plan to go?
questions.explanation_ar: اتفقا على 'Saturday night' وحجزت الفتاة طاولة الساعة السابعة.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الأيام الأخرى لم تُذكر؛ Saturday night هو اليوم الوحيد المتفق عليه.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: انتبه للوقت المحدد الذي وافق عليه الطرفان.

lessons.principle_en: Catch specific details — locations, documents, and requirements.
lessons.principle_ar: التقط التفاصيل المحددة — الأماكن، الوثائق، والمتطلبات.
lessons.strategy_ar: دوّن أي رقم، اسم مكتب، أو وثيقة تُذكر. هذه عادةً ما يُسأل عنها.

clips.context_ar: مقطع تمهيدي يوضح أسلوب طلب المعلومات
lines: Excuse me, where can I find the registrar's office?
It's on the second floor of the admin building.
Not for general inquiries. Just walk in.

clips.context_ar: طالب جديد يطلب بطاقة هويته الجامعية
lines: Hi, I'm a new student. Where do I get my ID card?
You'll need to go to the Student Services Office. It's in Building C.
Okay. What do I need to bring with me?
Your passport and the enrollment letter you received by email.
Got it. Is there a fee?
No, the first card is free. Just bring those two documents.

questions.q: Where should the student go to get the ID card?
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر بوضوح 'You'll need to go to the Student Services Office in Building C'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الخيارات الأخرى أماكن جامعية لكنها لا تُصدر بطاقات الهوية.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ابحث عن المكتب المسؤول عن خدمات الطلاب تحديداً.

questions.q: What documents does the student need to bring?
questions.explanation_ar: حدّدت الموظفة الوثيقتين: 'Your passport and the enrollment letter'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الجدول الدراسي والدفاتر ليست مطلوبة لإصدار البطاقة.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: استمع للوثيقتين المُحددتين بدقة.

lines: Hi, I haven't received my university email account yet.
Let me check. Can I have your student ID number?
Okay, I see your account is ready. You can activate it at the IT Help Desk.
Ground floor of the Library Building, next to the entrance.
Thank you. I'll go right now.

questions.q: What is the student's problem?
questions.explanation_ar: الطالبة قالت صراحةً 'I haven't received my university email account yet'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: بقية الخيارات لم تُذكر في الحوار.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: أول جملة من الطالبة تكشف المشكلة عادةً.

questions.q: Where is the IT Help Desk located?
options: Ground floor of the Library Building
questions.explanation_ar: حدّد الموظف الموقع: 'Ground floor of the Library Building, next to the entrance'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: المباني الأخرى لم تُذكر كمواقع للدعم التقني.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: انتبه للموقع المحدد بدقة.

lessons.principle_en: Recognize tone and feelings — is the speaker excited, worried, or hesitant?
lessons.principle_ar: اعرف النبرة والمشاعر — هل المتحدث متحمس، قلق، أم متردد؟
lessons.strategy_ar: لاحظ نبرة الصوت والكلمات العاطفية مثل 'great', 'worried', 'not sure'.

lines: Are you coming to the welcome party tonight?
I'd love to, but I have an early class tomorrow.
Just stop by for an hour. It'll be fun.
Maybe. I'll see how I feel after dinner.
Are you going to the student party on Friday?
Yes, definitely. My classmates from the engineering club are all going.
Oh nice. I wasn't sure if I should come alone.
You should come with us. The more, the merrier.
That's really kind. What time does it start?
Eight o'clock at the main hall. We can meet at the entrance.

questions.q: What event are the students talking about?
questions.explanation_ar: الحوار يدور حول 'student party on Friday'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: بقية الأحداث لم تُذكر في الحوار.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: الفكرة الرئيسية تتضح من السؤال الأول.

questions.q: Who is the male student going with?
questions.explanation_ar: قال 'My classmates from the engineering club are all going'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لم يُذكر الأستاذ أو العائلة، وهو ليس وحيداً.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: استمع لمن يرافقه.

lines: Have you ever joined the book club?
No, but I've been curious about it.
We meet every Thursday at six in the lounge. It's really relaxed.
What kind of books do you read?
Mostly modern fiction. This month we're reading a novel by a Japanese author.
Sounds interesting. Can I just show up?
Absolutely. New members are always welcome.

questions.q: How does the male speaker feel about joining?
questions.explanation_ar: قال 'I've been curious about it' و'Sounds interesting' — نبرة فضول واهتمام.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا يوجد ما يدل على الانزعاج أو الارتباك.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ركّز على الكلمات العاطفية: curious, interesting.

questions.q: When does the book club meet?
questions.explanation_ar: حُدد الموعد: 'every Thursday at six in the lounge'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الأوقات الأخرى لم تُذكر.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: انتبه لليوم والساعة بدقة.

lessons.principle_en: Catch task requirements — length, deadline, sources, and format.
lessons.principle_ar: التقط متطلبات المهمة — الطول، الموعد النهائي، المصادر، والصيغة.
lessons.strategy_ar: دوّن كل رقم وقيد ذُكر: عدد الصفحات، نوع المصادر، الموعد النهائي.

lines: When is the history assignment due?
And how long should it be?
Around 1500 words. Don't forget the bibliography.
Did you start the essay for Professor Adams?
Not yet. What were the requirements again?
Minimum five pages, double-spaced, and at least four academic sources.
Only peer-reviewed journals. No regular websites or blogs.
Got it. So online is fine if it's academic.
Exactly. The university library database has plenty.

questions.q: What is the required minimum length of the essay?
questions.explanation_ar: حدّد بوضوح 'Minimum five pages, double-spaced'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الأرقام الأخرى لم تُذكر.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ركّز على كلمة 'minimum' والرقم الذي يليها.

questions.q: Can the student use online sources?
questions.explanation_ar: قال صراحةً 'Only peer-reviewed journals. No regular websites or blogs'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الإجابة ليست مطلقة بنعم أو لا، بل مشروطة.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: انتبه للقيد المحدد على المصادر الإلكترونية.

lines: Quick question — how long should the presentation be?
Ten minutes maximum, including Q and A.
And do we need to use slides?
Slides are optional, but visuals are encouraged.
This one is individual. Group work comes later in the semester.

questions.q: What is the maximum length of the presentation?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكر 'Ten minutes maximum, including Q and A'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الأوقات الأخرى لم تُذكر.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ابحث عن كلمة 'maximum' والرقم.

questions.q: Can students work in pairs?
questions.explanation_ar: حُسم الأمر بـ 'This one is individual'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: العمل الجماعي مذكور لاحقاً في الفصل، ليس هذه المهمة.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: انتبه لكلمة individual.

lessons.principle_en: Identify locations and procedures — where to go and what to do.
lessons.principle_ar: حدّد الأماكن والإجراءات — إلى أين تذهب وماذا تفعل.
lessons.strategy_ar: ابحث عن عبارات الإرشاد مثل 'you should go to' أو 'first you need to'.

clips.context_ar: مقطع تمهيدي عن طلب نصيحة طبية
lines: I haven't been feeling well since yesterday.
Have you visited the campus clinic?
Not yet. Where is it exactly?
Behind the gym, next to the parking lot.
I think I'm coming down with a cold. Should I see a doctor?
You can go to the campus clinic. They handle minor illnesses.
Walk-ins are fine before noon. Just bring your student ID.
It's completely free for enrolled students. Even medicine is included.
Wow, that's great. I'll head there now.

questions.q: Where should the student go for help?
questions.explanation_ar: وُجّه إلى 'campus clinic' لعلاج الأمراض البسيطة.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الأماكن الأخرى لا تقدم خدمات طبية.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: ركّز على المكان المتخصص بالعلاج.

questions.q: Will the student have to pay for the consultation?
questions.explanation_ar: قِيلت العبارة 'completely free for enrolled students. Even medicine is included'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الدواء أيضاً مجاني، فالخيار 'only for medicine' خاطئ.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: كل الخدمات مجانية بدون استثناء.

lines: Hi, I need to refill my prescription. Can you help?
Of course. Do you have a copy of the original prescription?
Yes, it's right here from my doctor back home.
Perfect. We'll need to verify it, which takes about 24 hours.
The verification is free. The medicine itself depends on the insurance.
Then most likely it'll be covered. Come back tomorrow afternoon.

questions.q: What does the student want to do?
questions.explanation_ar: قالت 'I need to refill my prescription'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: ليس وصفة جديدة، بل تجديد القديمة.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: كلمة refill تعني تجديد.

questions.q: When should she come back?
questions.explanation_ar: حدد الموظف: 'Come back tomorrow afternoon' بعد التحقق الذي يأخذ 24 ساعة.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الأوقات الأخرى لم تُذكر.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: انتبه للوقت المحدد بعد التحقق.
